chunks: In the narration of al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, attributed upward:

A man swore that he would weigh an elephant, so the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: "He should put the elephant into a boat, then look at the place reached by the water from the boat and mark it. Then he should remove the elephant and cast into the boat iron, copper, or whatever he wishes. When it reaches the place that he marked, he should remove it and weigh it."

key_terms.مَبْلَغِ الْمَاءِ: the level reached by the water

ai.seo_question: How did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم instruct someone to weigh an elephant?
ai.summary: This hadith relates a practical method taught by the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم for determining the weight of an elephant by using displacement in a boat. It reflects applied reasoning in resolving a concrete problem and appears in the context of legal stratagems in rulings.
